Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.
THIS AGENDA HAS BEEN AMENDED TO INCLUDE THE FOLLOWING NOTICE: This meeting is being held pursuant to Executive Order N-25-20 issued by California Governor Gavin Newsom on March 12, 2020 to further the State's efforts to control the spread of COVID-19 Coronavirus. Any and all council members may attend and participate by teleconference/virtual meeting. Members of the public may also attend by teleconference in order to observe and provide public comment during the meeting. The meeting will not be livestreamed. If you wish to participate . . .

The public can also email comments on the agenda item to CityCouncilMeeting@pvestates.org. Public comments shall be limited to 250 words. Any public comments sent before 6:30 pm to this email will be read aloud during the appropriate time on the agenda. Agenda reports and other disclosable public documents relating to each Agenda Item are available on the City's website under City Council Meeting Agendas at www.pvestates.org.

 CITY COUNCIL MINUTES
 May 12, 2020
 Mayor McGowan requested that the previous Motion be taken separately as two separate Motions.
Councilmember Davidson concurred.

Moved by Mayor Pro Tern Kemps, Seconded by Councilmember Kao to open the Tennis Club pursuant
to the safety protocols presented in observance with County guidance.
Motion Carried by the following Roll Call Vote:
Aye: Lozzi, Kao , Davidson, Kemps, McGowan
No: none

Moved by Mayor Pro Tern Kemps to lift the parking restrictions along Bluff Cove and Paseo
Del Mar, and keep Malaga Cove parking lot closed. Motion failed due to lack of second.

STAFF REPORTS

  i. City Manager's Report

Acting City Manager provided an update on staffing and noted the upcoming UCLA Blood &
Platelets Drive. He also noted that the PV Stables are open for Boarders but activities remain closed.

  a. State of the Police Department

Interim Chief Dreiling provided an update on the PYE Cares task force.

MAYOR & CITY COUNCILMEMBERS' REPORTS

Councilmember Davidson reiterated his request for a grant writer and a request for a discussion
regarding the City Forester and Travers Tree Service.

Councilmember Kao welcomed Ms. Guglielmo and Ms. Chaney and expressed best wishes to Ms.
Banales.

Mayor Pro Tern Kemps requested that an annual Council and Planning Commission workshop, and
let a discussion of transparency items be added to a future agenda.
Mayor McGowan provided best wishes to Ms. Banales and welcomed Ms. Guglielmo and Ms.
Chaney.

There being no further business to come before the Council, Mayor McGowan adjourned the meeting
to the next Regular Meeting on May 26, 2020 at 6:30 pm.

RESPECTFULLY SUBMITTED,

  APPROVED:

  David McGowan, Mayor
